user.description: Choose a device to set up.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Confirm Device
bluetooth_confirm.description: To configure {name}, first put the device into pairing mode, then press Submit (Confirm).

select_model.title: Select Device Model
select_model.description: If the Bluetooth advertisement name includes a known code (for example **HEM-7600T**), it is selected for you—confirm or change it. Otherwise nothing is preselected: choose the model printed on the cuff or shown in Omron Connect. The list has **{model_total}** entries: **{profile_count}** hardware profiles plus **{variant_count}** regional or bundle codes that share a profile. If your exact code is missing, pick the closest model. The model decides how the cuff's memory is read, and a wrong choice gives empty or nonsensical readings with no error—check the log for **profile=** lines. It cannot be changed later without removing and re-adding the device.

user_aliases.title: User names on the cuff
user_aliases.description: This model stores **{num_users}** user profiles. Enter a short name for each (defaults: user1, user2, …). These names appear in sensor names and entity IDs instead of generic user numbers.

pairing.title: Pair {model}
pairing.description: Submit (Confirm) will start pairing from Home Assistant. First put the cuff in pairing mode—for most models, hold the Bluetooth button until **-P-** appears—then press Submit.

pairing_os.title: Pair {model}
pairing_os.description: Submit (Confirm) will start pairing from Home Assistant. First set the device to pairing or discoverable mode as in the manual, then press Submit.

select_model_unknown.title: Select Device Model
select_model_unknown.description: The device reports its model number as **{probed_model}**, which is in no list here, so nothing is preselected. Choose the model printed on the cuff or shown in Omron Connect. The list has **{model_total}** entries: **{profile_count}** hardware profiles plus **{variant_count}** regional or bundle codes that share a profile. If your exact code is missing, pick the closest model. The model decides how the cuff's memory is read, and a wrong choice gives empty or nonsensical readings with no error—check the log for **profile=** lines. It cannot be changed later without removing and re-adding the device.

select_model_ambiguous.title: Select Device Model
select_model_ambiguous.description:
The device reports its model number as **{probed_model}**. **{candidate_count}** models answer to that name and they do not read alike:

{candidates}

Nothing the cuff sends over the air tells them apart—the Omron app knows only because you told it. Pick the one printed on the cuff.

The list has **{model_total}** entries: **{profile_count}** hardware profiles plus **{variant_count}** regional or bundle codes that share a profile. If your exact code is missing, pick the closest model. The model decides how the cuff's memory is read, and a wrong choice gives empty or nonsensical readings with no error—check the log for **profile=** lines. It cannot be changed later without removing and re-adding the device.

error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed. Make sure the device is in pairing mode (-P- on display) and try again.
error.decryption_failed: The provided bindkey did not work, sensor data could not be decrypted. Please check it and try again.
error.duplicate_user_aliases: Each user slot must have a different name (case-insensitive).
error.invalid_scan_interval: Enter 0 (no scheduled polling) or at least 60 seconds.

abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured devices found on the network
abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress
abort.model_not_selected: The device model was not selected. Start over and pick the model from the list.

weight.title: User
weight.description: Each new measurement goes to the user whose usual weight is closest. Enter the weight you normally see on the scale; it is used until this user has measurements of their own. Users whose weights are closer than about 5.5 kg (at 75 kg) are often left unassigned. Unassigned measurements are announced in an `omron_unassigned_measurement` event. The height is only used for the BMI.

data_description.person: Optional. A measurement is not given to this user if this person was not home when it was taken. The state is read from the recorder at the time the device recorded, so the device's clock must be right. Without a recorded state, or a time, the user stays a candidate.

rules.title: User
rules.description: Each new measurement goes to the one user whose rules all match. Leave a rule empty to ignore it. Write time windows as HH:MM-HH:MM separated by commas; a window may cross midnight (22:00-02:00). Value ranges are only a hint and can misassign. A measurement that fits several users, or none, is given to nobody and announced in an `omron_unassigned_measurement` event. The time is the one the device recorded, so its clock must be right.

data_description.person: Optional. A measurement is not given to this user if this person was not home when it was taken. The state is read from the recorder at the time the device recorded, so the device's clock must be right. Without a recorded state, or a time, the user stays a candidate.

pressure.title: User
pressure.description: Each new reading goes to the one user whose rules all match. Leave a rule empty to ignore it. Write time windows as HH:MM-HH:MM separated by commas; a window may cross midnight (22:00-02:00). Value ranges are only a hint and can misassign. A reading that fits several users, or none, is given to nobody and announced in an `omron_unassigned_measurement` event. The time is the one the device recorded, so its clock must be right.

data_description.person: Optional. A measurement is not given to this user if this person was not home when it was taken. The state is read from the recorder at the time the device recorded, so the device's clock must be right. Without a recorded state, or a time, the user stays a candidate.

confirm_no_rules.title: No rules
confirm_no_rules.description: {name} has no rules, so every measurement fits this user, and a measurement that also fits another user is given to nobody. Press Submit to save anyway, or close this dialog and add a rule.

confirm_overlap.title: Overlapping time windows
confirm_overlap.description: The time windows of {name} overlap with those of: {others}. A measurement that fits both is given to nobody unless a value range tells them apart. Press Submit to save anyway.

slot.title: User
slot.description: Each measurement taken on the chosen slot of the scale goes to this user. Pick the slot this person uses on the scale. A slot can belong to one user only; measurements of a slot nobody picked are ignored. The height is only used for the BMI.

error.invalid_name: Enter a name that no other user has.
error.invalid_range: The lower value must not be above the upper value.
error.slot_taken: Another user already has this slot.

init.title: Omron Bluetooth
init.description:
How often Home Assistant should poll the blood pressure monitor for new readings (60–86400 seconds). Lower values use more battery on the cuff. Set 0 to turn scheduled polling off. Cuffs that signal a pending transfer are still read on their own; the others update only when you press Refresh Data.

**Profile slots on this device:** {num_users}. When there is more than one, set a display name per slot below (defaults user1, user2, …). Renaming a slot creates new sensor entities for that slot.

data.sync_stored_records: Publish every measurement stored since the last poll

data_description.assignment_strategy: Weight: the user whose usual weight is closest. Rules: the time windows and value ranges set per user. Changing this forgets the weights learned so far. After changing it, edit each user: assigning by weight needs their usual weight, assigning by rules needs their rules. A user without a usual weight is never assigned by weight.
data_description.weight_tolerance_pct: How far a weight may be from a user's usual weight, in percent (1–5); the tolerance is held between 1.0 and 4.0 kg. Users whose usual weights are closer than about 5.5 kg (at 75 kg) are often left unassigned.

error.duplicate_user_aliases: Each user slot must have a different name (case-insensitive).
error.invalid_scan_interval: Enter 0 (no scheduled polling) or at least 60 seconds.

height_out_of_range.message: Height must be 0 (to clear) or between {min} and {max} cm.

unknown_measurement.message: There is no measurement with the id {measurement_id}. Only the newest 50 measurements of each device are kept.

not_a_user.message: The chosen device is not a user.

user_other_device.message: The chosen user belongs to another device than the measurement.

reassign_measurement.name: Reassign measurement
reassign_measurement.description: Moves a measurement that was already handled to another user, or to nobody. Take the measurement id from the `omron_unassigned_measurement` event or from a user sensor's attributes. Only the newest 50 measurements of each device are kept.

measurement_id.name: Measurement ID
measurement_id.description: The id of the measurement, as in the `omron_unassigned_measurement` event or a user sensor's `measurement_id` attribute.

user.name: User
user.description: The device of the user to give the measurement to. Leave it empty to give it to nobody.
